messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm planning a short rolling migration of the terraform backend for overlay state (dev/staging/prod). Need a quick sanity check before I open the PR.

alex: Current situation: each overlay uses a separate state path in the same S3 bucket. We want to move to namespaced prefixes and enable backend locks via DynamoDB. Goal is clearer separation + safer cross-team applies.

maria: sounds good. what are the exact path changes? any risk of a double-apply during cutover?

alex: path change will be: s3://redwood-tfstate/overlays/<env>/<service> -> s3://redwood-tfstate/namespaces/<team>/<env>/<service>

alex: Terraform backend snippet I'm proposing:

```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "redwood-tfstate"
    key    = "namespaces/${var.team}/${var.env}/${var.service}/terraform.tfstate"
    region = "us-west-2"
    dynamodb_table = "redwood-tf-locks"
  }
}
```

sanjeev: make sure var.team is set in CI for existing pipelines, otherwise plan will try to create a new state. we should add a guard in the runbook.

olivia: +1 on runbook. also, will this impact k8s secret wiring? some overlays reference the S3 path in docs for restores. need to update docs and ops runbook.

alex: good catch — I have a docs PR branch (WIP). I can update restore steps and the terraform import/relocation commands. plan is to do migrate commands per-state:

```bash
# on an operator machine with creds
terraform init -backend-config="key=overlays/prod/service-a/terraform.tfstate"
terraform state mv -state-out=namespaces/platform/prod/service-a/terraform.tfstate <root_module>
# then re-init with new backend config
```

maria: hm, prefer using `terraform init -migrate-state` with explicit backend configs instead of manual state mv to avoid subtle issues. also schedule during a low-traffic window.

alex: agreed. scheduling window: Sat 02:00-04:00 PT. Will coordinate with oncall.

infra-bot: FYI — scheduled maintenance request created: #MT-4732 (pending approvals).

sanjeev: do we need to update CI/CD pipeline templates that set TF_WORKSPACE or backend configs? I think our tokenized pipeline uses `TF_STATE_KEY` currently.

alex: yes — I'll open a small template PR to switch to TF_BACKEND_KEY and ensure var.team injection. will tag infra-apps for review.

olivia: for overlays that reference imagePullSecrets or external secret paths, we should run a quick grep across overlays to catch hardcoded state paths. I can run and post results.

maria: also add a pre-promote gating check: after migration, run `terraform plan` against staging overlay and compare diffs to ensure no drift. If diff non-empty, block promote.

alex: that's the plan. PR will include a gating checklist and `canary-promote` step: migrate dev -> run plan -> migrate staging -> run plan -> migrate prod.

olivia: I ran a quick grep. Two overlays still reference `overlays/prod/` in restore docs: infra/k8s/redis and infra/k8s/ingress. I'll submit tiny doc fixes.

alex: thanks. I'll post the PR here when ready. Requesting final sanity review from @maria and @sanjeev before I merge.

maria: lgtm from me, just ensure the runbook has rollback steps (restore from S3 copy + re-point key)

sanjeev: ok from me. add me as approver on the MT ticket.

alex: done — ticket updated. merging PR will be gated until approvals + manual 1hr hold after dev migration for observation.

infra-bot: Reminder — add DynamoDB table creation to infra provisioning run (PR #382).

alex: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:
